name: Neck Stretch
description: Gently tilt your head to the left and right to stretch your neck muscles.
steps: Slowly tilt your head to the left, hold for 5 seconds.
Return to center, then tilt to the right, hold for 5 seconds.

name: Shoulder Roll
description: Roll your shoulders forward and backward to loosen up.
steps: Roll your shoulders forward in a circular motion 5 times.
Then roll your shoulders backward 5 times.

name: Push Up
description: A basic upper body strength exercise.
steps: Start in a plank position with hands under shoulders.
Lower your body until your chest nearly touches the floor.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
description: Stretch the front of your thigh.
steps: Stand upright and hold onto a wall for balance if needed.
Grab your right ankle with your right hand and pull your heel toward your buttock.
Hold for 20 seconds, then switch sides.
